page.description: A small studio for Emojiful emoji packs. Organize image URLs, names and categories for Minecraft.
page.noscript: Enable JavaScript to edit emoji packs.
confirm.newPack: Replace the current draft with an empty pack. Save the draft JSON first if needed.
descriptionPlaceholder: A few words about this pack
storage.failed: Cannot autosave. Save as JSON instead
storage.restoreFailed: Could not load the saved draft. Restore it from a JSON backup.
intro.title: A home for your emojis.
intro.description: Collect your favorite images and bring them to Minecraft.
searchPlaceholder: Search by name, category or URL…
empty.title: Start with your first emoji.
empty.description: Add an image URL, a name and a category.
empty.bulkHelp: Have many? Add them together with bulk input.
empty.bulk: Start with CSV or a URL list
export.title: Bring them to Minecraft.
overwrite: Overwrite a managed pack with the same ID
runtime.modHelp: Reopen the world or use /reload to apply changes. Multiplayer requires installation on the server.
runtime.staticHelp: Put the ZIP in the world's datapacks folder and use /reload. The mod's localhost GUI also supports direct installation.
runtime.imagesHelp: Images are referenced by URL and are not included in the ZIP. Entries are kept even when a preview fails.
installed.title: Installed packs
imageUrlHelp: A direct URL to a PNG, GIF, JPG or another image supported by Emojiful
bulk.description: Paste CSV, TSV, JSON or one image URL per line. Entries are added to the existing collection.
bulk.file: Choose a CSV, TSV or JSON file
bulk.csvHelp: CSV/TSV accepts name, url, category headers. Without headers, use name, URL, category or URL, name, category. Category is optional.
bulk.urlHelp: URL lists use image filenames as emoji names. Fix duplicate names before importing. Any error cancels the entire import.
confirm.title: Confirm changes
confirm.replace: Replace the current draft with the imported pack. Save the draft JSON first if needed.
notice.deployed: Installed {filename}. Reopen the world or use /reload to apply changes.
error.fieldLength: {field} must contain {min}–{max} characters without line breaks or control characters.
error.emojiName: Emoji names accept lowercase Latin letters, digits, _ and -. They cannot start with -.
error.urlFull: Enter a full image URL starting with http:// or https://.
error.urlSafe: Use an HTTP(S) image URL without credentials or spaces.
error.packId: Pack IDs accept lowercase Latin letters, digits and _.
error.nameUsed: The emoji name “{name}” is already in use.
error.packSize: Pack data is limited to 1.5 MiB. Shorten URLs or split the pack.
error.jsonArray: Enter a JSON array or a project containing an emojis array.
error.columns: Line {line}: check the name, URL and category columns.
error.zipSize: ZIP files are limited to 4 MiB.
error.zipExpanded: The ZIP contains too many files or exceeds the expanded size limit.
error.directInstall: Direct installation is available in Minecraft's localhost GUI.
error.session: The local session is invalid. Refresh the page and try again.
error.notFound: The pack could not be found. Refresh the installed pack list.
error.conflict: A pack with this ID already exists or cannot be overwritten. Enable overwrite for managed packs or use a different ID.
error.request: The server rejected the pack data. Check the pack and try again.
error.server: Could not read or save the pack. Check the Minecraft log.
error.network: Could not connect to the local GUI. Check that Minecraft is running, then refresh the page.
mod.chat.unavailable: Emojiful Web GUI could not start. Check the game log for details.
packs.deleteConfirm: Delete “{name}”? This removes this pack’s draft and emojis saved in this browser.
folder.directHelp: Use “Save to folder” to apply changes to the original folder.
folder.readOnly: This browser can only read folders. Export a ZIP after editing.
folder.permission: Folder access was not granted. Allow access in your browser and try again.
folder.conflict: The folder changed externally or a destination contains another file. Keep your current draft and reopen the folder.
folder.invalid: Select the root folder of an emoji pack.
folder.tooLarge: Pack data in this folder exceeds the size or file count limit.
folder.writeFailed: Could not save to the folder. Changed files were restored.
folder.rollbackFailed: Saving failed and some files could not be restored. Check the folder.
folder.sessionOnly: The folder connection lasts only while this page is open. Reopen it after reloading.
folder.unsaved: There are changes not yet saved to the folder.
